note: Set A binds most dimensions to the correct detail (Module A values 6 3/16", 1'-11 1/8", 4 3/4" and Module B values 5/8", 3'-6", 1 1/2" all match the text-layer blocks) and correctly captures the 3/8" through bolt and L3X3X1/4 angle. Set B misassigns 10'-3 3/4" (a Module B dimension) to Module A and 2'-3 7/8" (a Module A dimension) to Module B, and invents a quote "12' 2 5/8"" that does not appear anywhere in the text layer. Set B also fabricates several conditions and bindings (base block hole offset "from top", "top extension", "bottom section", flange width, left/right offset distances) that the drawing text does not state. Both sets contain the unsupported "L300x14" quote and vague "component"/"dimension" entities, but Set A has fewer outright misbindings and invented content.
